-- benchmark: benchmarks/black_scholes.json
-- benchmark-id: mf-smile-black-form-tail-iff
-- source-issue: 318
-- deferred: SVI tail lemmas re-derived as corollaries of the general lemma; left-wing bound: IsNormalizedCallPrice (bsSmile p) implies b(1 - rho) ≤ 2, and the mass at zero; calendar-spread martingale step for any convex payoff via conditional Jensen; t > 0 calendar statements tied to the local-variance characterisation; unification of blackForm, totalVarianceCall and logBlackCall into one (k, w) Black form; IsNormalizedCallPrice from a nonnegative random variable with mean 1 (easy direction); port hygiene: scoped maxHeartbeats, maxRecDepth and open scoped Classical
-- blueprint: thm:smile-no-arbitrage

/-!
# Tail condition for the Black form at general positive total variance

For any everywhere-positive total variance `w`, the Black form `blackForm k (w k)` tends to 0 at
large `k` exactly when `d₊(k, w k)` tends to `-∞`.

## Main results

* `blackForm_tendsto_zero_iff_dpl_tendsto_atBot`: Tail condition for the Black form at general
  positive total variance

## References

* [Roper, *Arbitrage free implied volatility surfaces*][Roper2010]

## Tags

tail condition, black form, total variance, d plus, call price, no-arbitrage, smile, MSC 91G20
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

@[expose] public section

namespace MathFin

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- For any everywhere-positive total variance `w`, the Black form `blackForm k (w k)` tends to
`0` as `k → +∞` iff `dpl k (w k)` tends to `-∞`. -/
theorem blackForm_tendsto_zero_iff_dpl_tendsto_atBot (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun k ↦ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k (w k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ↔
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k ↦ MathFin.ForwardSmile.dpl k (w k)) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot := by
  sorry

end MathFin

/-- **With a wing slope of at least `2` the call does not vanish at large strikes.** Eventually
`Φ(d₊) ≥ δ := Φ(−|a − 2m|/2) > 0`, while by the Mills bound
`eᵏΦ(d₋) ≤ φ(d₊)/|d₋| ≤ 1/|d₋| ≤ 2/√w`, which is at most `δ/2` once `√w ≥ 4/δ`. -/
theorem not_tendsto_bsSmile_zero (p : Params) (hb : 0 ≤ p.b)
    (hw : ∀ k : ℝ, 0 < variance p k) (hc : 2 ≤ p.b * (1 + p.rho)) :
    ¬ Tendsto (bsSmile p) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  intro h
  set δ := MathFin.Phi (-(|p.a - 2 * p.m| / 2))
  have hδ : 0 < δ := (MathFin.Phi_mem_Ioo _).1
  obtain ⟨k, hsmall, ⟨hlow, hR⟩, hk0⟩ :=
    ((Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.eventually ((tendsto_order.1 h).2 (δ / 2) (half_pos hδ))).and
      ((eventually_le_dpl p hb hw hc (4 / δ)).and (eventually_ge_atTop 0))).exists
  have hr := rootVariance_pos p k (hw k)
  rw [← blackCall_eq_bsSmile p _ (Real.exp_pos k)
    (by rw [Real.log_exp]; exact hw k)] at hsmall
  simp only [blackCall, ForwardSmile.blackForm, Real.log_exp] at hsmall
  have hE : 0 ≤ Real.exp k * MathFin.Phi (dmi k (variance p k)) :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos k).le (MathFin.Phi_nonneg _)
  -- the Mills bound, transported by `eᵏφ(d₋) = φ(d₊)`
  have hmills :
      -dmi k (variance p k) * (Real.exp k * MathFin.Phi (dmi k (variance p k))) ≤ 1 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_mul_Phi_le_gaussianPDFReal (dmi k (variance p k)))
      (Real.exp_pos k).le
    rw [ForwardSmile.exp_mul_pdf_dmi (hw k)] at this
    linarith [gaussianPDFReal_zero_one_le_one (dpl k (variance p k))]
  have hd : 2 / δ ≤ -dmi k (variance p k) := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ k / rootVariance p k := div_nonneg hk0 hr.le
    have h2 : 4 / δ / 2 = 2 / δ := by ring
    simp only [dmi_eq_rootVariance, neg_div]
    linarith
  have h3 := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd hE).trans hmills
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hδ] at h3
  linarith [MathFin.strictMono_Phi.monotone hlow]

/-- **The call price at large strikes**: the SVI-smiled call tends to `0` exactly when the right
wing slope `b(1 + ρ)` is below `2`. -/
theorem tendsto_bsSmile_zero_iff (p : Params) (hb : 0 ≤ p.b)
    (hw : ∀ k : ℝ, 0 < variance p k) :
    Tendsto (bsSmile p) atTop (𝓝 0) ↔ p.b * (1 + p.rho) < 2 :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ not_le.1 fun hc ↦ not_tendsto_bsSmile_zero p hb hw hc h, tendsto_bsSmile_zero p hb hw⟩

/-! ### The call price function -/

/-- For a raw SVI smile with positive variance and `b ≥ 0`, the smiled call is a normalised call
price function exactly when it is convex in the strike and the right wing slope is below `2`. -/
theorem isNormalizedCallPrice_bsSmile_iff (p : Params) (hb : 0 ≤ p.b)
    (hw : ∀ k : ℝ, 0 < variance p k) :
    IsNormalizedCallPrice (bsSmile p) ↔
      ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) (bsSmile p) ∧ p.b * (1 + p.rho) < 2 :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.convexOn, (tendsto_bsSmile_zero_iff p hb hw).1 h.tendsto_zero⟩, fun h ↦
    .of_convexOn h.1
      (fun _ hK ↦ max_le (one_sub_le_bsSmile p hK (hw _)) (bsSmile_nonneg p hK (hw _)))
      (fun _ hK ↦ bsSmile_le_one p hK (hw _)) (tendsto_bsSmile_zero p hb hw h.2)⟩

/-! ### The sign formula -/

/-- The strike-convexity formula together with the sign atom `2 − b(1 + ρ) > 0` of the tail
condition. -/
noncomputable def butterflyFreeFormula : SignFormula :=
  .and extendedCertificateFormula
    (positiveAtom (2 - MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 5) * (1 + MvPolynomial.X (2 : Fin 5))))

/-- `butterflyFreeFormula` holds exactly when the strike-convexity conditions do and the right
wing slope is below `2`. -/
theorem butterflyFreeFormula_eval (p : Params) :
    butterflyFreeFormula.eval p = true ↔
      (0 ≤ p.sigma ∧ 0 ≤ p.b ∧ 0 ≤ 1 - p.rho ^ 2 ∧ (∀ k : ℝ, 0 < variance p k) ∧
        ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) (bsSmile p)) ∧ p.b * (1 + p.rho) < 2 := by
  have he : parameterEval p (2 - MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 5) * (1 + MvPolynomial.X (2 : Fin 5)))
      = 2 - p.b * (1 + p.rho) := by

/-- Total implied variance along the surface: `w = σ_BS²·T`. -/
noncomputable def totalVar (σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T : ℝ) : ℝ := smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T ^ 2 * T

/-- The upper standardized normal argument in `(k, w)` coordinates:
`d₊ = (−k + w/2)/√w` (this is `bsd1 F (F·e^k) 0 σ̃ T` at `w = σ̃²T`). -/
noncomputable def dpl (k w : ℝ) : ℝ := (-k + w / 2) / Real.sqrt w

/-- The lower standardized normal argument: `d₋ = (−k − w/2)/√w`. -/
noncomputable def dmi (k w : ℝ) : ℝ := (-k - w / 2) / Real.sqrt w

/-- `d₊ = −k/√w + √w/2`: the form in which `d₊` is written when `w` is a squared root variance
(for `w ≤ 0` both sides are `0`, as `√w = 0`). -/
theorem dpl_eq (k w : ℝ) : dpl k w = -k / Real.sqrt w + Real.sqrt w / 2 := by
  rw [dpl, add_div, div_right_comm, Real.div_sqrt]

/-- `d₋ = −k/√w − √w/2`, as `dpl_eq`. -/
theorem dmi_eq (k w : ℝ) : dmi k w = -k / Real.sqrt w - Real.sqrt w / 2 := by
  rw [dmi, sub_div, div_right_comm, Real.div_sqrt]

/-- The Black-76 call normalized by the forward: `c(k,w) = Φ(d₊) − e^k·Φ(d₋)`,
the zero-rates `bsV` in `(k, w)` coordinates. -/
noncomputable def blackForm (k w : ℝ) : ℝ := Phi (dpl k w) - Real.exp k * Phi (dmi k w)

/-- **The call price on the tilted surface**: the zero-rates
`bsV` at strike `K = F·e^k`, spot `S = F`, vol `σ_BS(ε,k,T)`, maturity `T`. -/
noncomputable def bsCallSmile (F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  bsV (F * Real.exp k) 0 (smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) F T

/-- **Dupire's zero-rates ratio in k-form** (the ratio as a
definition — its derivation from a local-vol model is not developed here):
`R = 2·C_T/(C_kk − C_k)`, using `K²·∂²_K C = C_kk − C_k` for
`K = F·e^k`. -/
noncomputable def dupireRatio (F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * deriv (fun t ↦ bsCallSmile F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k t) T
    / (deriv (fun x ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ bsCallSmile F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε x T) x) k
        - deriv (fun x ↦ bsCallSmile F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε x T) k)

/-! ## The `(k, w)` unfolding and the variance chains -/

/-- **The r=0, K=F·e^k magic identity**: `e^k·ϕ(d₋) = ϕ(d₊)` in `(k,w)`
coordinates — the k-form of the `bs_identity` at zero rates. It is
what makes every density term in the Dupire ratio collapse. -/
theorem exp_mul_pdf_dmi {k w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    Real.exp k * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (dmi k w) = gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (dpl k w) := by
  have hsq : dpl k w ^ 2 - dmi k w ^ 2 = -(2 * k) := by
    have hnum : (-k + w / 2) ^ 2 - (-k - w / 2) ^ 2 = -(2 * k) * w := by ring
    have h1 : dpl k w ^ 2 = (-k + w / 2) ^ 2 / w := by
      unfold dpl
      rw [show ((-k + w / 2) / Real.sqrt w) ^ 2 = (-k + w / 2) ^ 2 / Real.sqrt w ^ 2 from by
          ring, Real.sq_sqrt hw.le]
    have h2 : dmi k w ^ 2 = (-k - w / 2) ^ 2 / w := by
      unfold dmi
      rw [show ((-k - w / 2) / Real.sqrt w) ^ 2 = (-k - w / 2) ^ 2 / Real.sqrt w ^ 2 from by
          ring, Real.sq_sqrt hw.le]
    rw [h1, h2, ← sub_div, hnum]
    field_simp [hw.ne']
  unfold gaussianPDFReal
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, mul_one, sub_zero]
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.exp k) (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹, mul_assoc,
    ← Real.exp_add,
    show k + -(dmi k w) ^ 2 / 2 = -(dpl k w) ^ 2 / 2 from by linarith [hsq]]

/-- **`d₁` in `(k, w)` coordinates**: at zero rates and strike `K = F·e^k`, `bsd1` is the upper
standardized normal argument `d₊(k, σ²T)`. -/
theorem bsd1_eq_dpl {F k σ T : ℝ} (hF : F ≠ 0) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    bsd1 F (F * Real.exp k) 0 σ T = dpl k (σ ^ 2 * T) := by
  have hlog : Real.log (F / (F * Real.exp k)) = -k := by
    rw [show F / (F * Real.exp k) = (Real.exp k)⁻¹ by field_simp, Real.log_inv, Real.log_exp]
  have hden : σ * Real.sqrt T ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hσ.ne' (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT).ne'
  have hsplit : Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 * T) = σ * Real.sqrt T := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg σ) T, Real.sqrt_sq hσ.le]
  unfold bsd1 dpl
  rw [hlog, hsplit]
  field_simp [hden]
  ring

/-- **The `(k, w)` unfolding**: at zero rates with `K = F·e^k`, the `bsV`
composite on the tilted surface is the forward-normalized Black form at the
total variance `w = σ_BS²·T`. -/
theorem bsCallSmile_eq {F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T : ℝ} (hF : 0 < F) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hst : 0 < smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) :
    bsCallSmile F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T = F * blackForm k (totalVar σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) := by
  have hne : smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T * Real.sqrt T ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero hst.ne' (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT).ne'
  have hsplit : Real.sqrt (smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T ^ 2 * T)
      = smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T * Real.sqrt T := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _) T, Real.sqrt_sq hst.le]
  have hbsd1 : bsd1 F (F * Real.exp k) 0 (smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) T
      = dpl k (totalVar σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) := bsd1_eq_dpl hF.ne' hst hT
  have hbsd2 : bsd2 F (F * Real.exp k) 0 (smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) T
      = dmi k (totalVar σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) := by
    unfold bsd2
    rw [hbsd1]
    unfold dmi dpl totalVar
    rw [hsplit]
    field_simp [hne]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hT.le]
    ring
  unfold bsCallSmile bsV blackForm
  rw [hbsd1, hbsd2]
  norm_num [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_zero]
  ring

/-- `∂_k σ_BS = ε·ψ₁/√(T+T₀)` — the surface is affine in `k`. -/
private theorem hasDerivAt_smileSurface_k {σ ψ₁ T₀ ε T x : ℝ} :
    HasDerivAt (fun y ↦ smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε y T) (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀)) x := by
  have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ ↦ σ + (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀)) * y)
      (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀)) x := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀))).add_const σ
  refine h0.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
  filter_upwards with y
  unfold smileSurface
  field_simp

/-- `∂_k w = 2·σ̃·(ε·ψ₁/√(T+T₀))·T` — the `k`-chain of the total variance. -/
private theorem hasDerivAt_totalVar_k {σ ψ₁ T₀ ε T x : ℝ} :
    HasDerivAt (fun y ↦ totalVar σ ψ₁ T₀ ε y T)
      (2 * smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε x T * (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀)) * T) x :=
  ((hasDerivAt_smileSurface_k.fun_pow 2).mul_const T).congr_deriv (by ring)

/-!
# Tail condition for the Black form at general positive total variance

For any everywhere-positive total variance `w`, the Black form `blackForm k (w k)` tends to 0 at
large `k` exactly when `d₊(k, w k)` tends to `-∞`.

## Main results

* `blackForm_tendsto_zero_iff_dpl_tendsto_atBot`: Tail condition for the Black form at general
  positive total variance

## References

* [Roper, *Arbitrage free implied volatility surfaces*][Roper2010]

## Tags

tail condition, black form, total variance, d plus, call price, no-arbitrage, smile, MSC 91G20
-/

namespace MathFin

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- For any everywhere-positive total variance `w`, the Black form `blackForm k (w k)` tends to
`0` as `k → +∞` iff `dpl k (w k)` tends to `-∞`. -/
theorem blackForm_tendsto_zero_iff_dpl_tendsto_atBot (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun k ↦ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k (w k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ↔
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k ↦ MathFin.ForwardSmile.dpl k (w k)) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot := by
  have hmills (k : ℝ) : -dmi k (w k) * (Real.exp k * Phi (dmi k (w k))) ≤ 1 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_mul_Phi_le_gaussianPDFReal (dmi k (w k)))
      (Real.exp_pos k).le
    rw [exp_mul_pdf_dmi (hw k)] at this
    linarith [gaussianPDFReal_zero_one_le_one (dpl k (w k))]
  have hdiff (k : ℝ) : dmi k (w k) = dpl k (w k) - Real.sqrt (w k) := by
    rw [dmi_eq, dpl_eq]; ring
  have hs (k : ℝ) : 0 < Real.sqrt (w k) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hw k)
  have hE (k : ℝ) : 0 ≤ Real.exp k * Phi (dmi k (w k)) :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos k).le (Phi_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine tendsto_atBot.2 fun y ↦ ?_
    set δ := Phi (-|y|) with hδdef
    have hδ : 0 < δ := (Phi_mem_Ioo _).1
    set R := 4 / δ
    have hR : 0 < R := by positivity
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.1 h).2 (δ / 2) (half_pos hδ),
      eventually_ge_atTop (max 0 (R * (R / 2 + |y|)))] with k hlt hk
    by_contra hy
    have hy' : y < dpl k (w k) := not_le.1 hy
    have hk0 : 0 ≤ k := (le_max_left _ _).trans hk
    have hkR : R * (R / 2 + |y|) ≤ k := (le_max_right _ _).trans hk
    have hsd := dpl_eq k (w k)
    have hs0 := hs k
    have hRs : R < Real.sqrt (w k) := by
      by_contra hle
      have hle := not_lt.1 hle
      have hk1 : k = Real.sqrt (w k) * (Real.sqrt (w k) / 2 - dpl k (w k)) := by
        rw [hsd]; field_simp; ring
      have : Real.sqrt (w k) * (Real.sqrt (w k) / 2 - dpl k (w k))
          < R * (R / 2 + |y|) := by
        have h2 : Real.sqrt (w k) / 2 - dpl k (w k) < R / 2 + |y| := by
          linarith [neg_abs_le y]
        calc _ < Real.sqrt (w k) * (R / 2 + |y|) :=
              mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2 hs0
          _ ≤ R * (R / 2 + |y|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hd : 2 / δ ≤ -dmi k (w k) := by
      have h1 : 0 ≤ k / Real.sqrt (w k) := div_nonneg hk0 hs0.le
      have h2 : 4 / δ / 2 = 2 / δ := by ring
      rw [dmi_eq]
      have : 4 / δ < Real.sqrt (w k) := hRs
      rw [neg_sub', neg_div]
      linarith
    have h3 := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (hE k)).trans (hmills k)
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hδ] at h3
    have h4 : δ ≤ Phi (dpl k (w k)) :=
      strictMono_Phi.monotone (by linarith [neg_abs_le y])
    have h5 : blackForm k (w k) = Phi (dpl k (w k)) - Real.exp k * Phi (dmi k (w k)) := rfl
    have h6 : Real.exp k * Phi (dmi k (w k)) ≤ δ / 2 := by
      have hd0 : 0 < 2 / δ := by positivity
      have : 2 / δ * (Real.exp k * Phi (dmi k (w k))) ≤ 1 :=
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (hE k)).trans (hmills k)
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hδ] at this
      linarith
    linarith
  · have hΦ : Tendsto (fun k ↦ Phi (dpl k (w k))) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_Phi_atBot.comp h
    have hneg : Tendsto (fun k ↦ -dmi k (w k)) atTop atTop := by
      refine tendsto_atTop_mono (fun k ↦ ?_) (tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop.comp h)
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hdiff]
      linarith [hs k]
    have hE0 : Tendsto (fun k ↦ Real.exp k * Phi (dmi k (w k))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds
        (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hneg) (Eventually.of_forall hE) ?_
      filter_upwards [hneg.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with k hk
      rw [Function.comp_apply, ← one_div, le_div_iff₀ hk]
      linarith [hmills k]
    simpa [blackForm] using hΦ.sub hE0

end MathFin
